# Dotan Veretzky — Personal Website

> Software Engineer & Indie Game Developer based in Israel.

## About

Dotan Veretzky (born 1994) is a full-stack developer with a background in electronics and low-voltage systems. He builds software that feels effortless to use, with experience across web, desktop, games, and payment-gateway integrations.

- Email: dotanvg@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dotan-v/
- GitHub: https://github.com/DotanVG
- Itch.io: https://dotanv.itch.io/

## Experience

**Integration QA Specialist — Zota** (2025–Present)
Builds and hardens payment-gateway integrations for a global fintech. API integrations, security, compliance, and scalability.

**SAP Implementation & Training Specialist — Ness Technologies** (2024–2025)
Rolled out and trained the SAP IS-H system at Soroka Medical Center.

**Software Full-Stack Developer — Kanomi LTD** (2022–2024)
End-to-end Windows applications, branded Chromium browsers, Chrome extensions (C# WPF, Vite, JavaScript).

**Low-Voltage Systems Field Technician — Electra Megason LTD** (2019–2020)
Installation and maintenance of surveillance, fire-detection, CCTV, and access-control systems.

## Education

- Nitzanim — Gifted Youth Programme

## Tech Stack

Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Three.js / React Three Fiber, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, C# WPF, Chromium/Chrome Extensions, SAP IS-H.

## Site

This site has two modes: a clean portfolio view and a 3-D explorable world built with React Three Fiber and Rapier physics.

Source: https://github.com/DotanVG/Dotan-Personal-Website
Live: https://dotanv.vercel.app
